title: द्व्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Krishna travels with ten great warriors and a host of attendants through prosperous lands, while evil omens appear and the people come out to see him. He halts for the night at Vrikasthala, where he performs the evening rites and feeds the Brahmins.
summary.kn: ಹತ್ತು ಮಹಾರಥರು ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿವಾರದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಸಮೃದ್ಧ ನಾಡುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಪಶಕುನಗಳು ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಜನರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಕಾಣಲು ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವೃಕಸ್ಥಲದಲ್ಲಿ ರಾತ್ರಿ ತಂಗಿ ಸಂಧ್ಯಾಕರ್ಮ ಮಾಡಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರಿಗೆ ಭೋಜನ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: श्रीकृष्ण दस महारथियों और सेवकों के दल के साथ समृद्ध देशों से होकर यात्रा करते हैं, जबकि अपशकुन प्रकट होते हैं और लोग उन्हें देखने निकल आते हैं। वे रात को वृकस्थल में ठहरते हैं, जहाँ सन्ध्या कर्म कर ब्राह्मणों को भोजन कराते हैं।
summary.te: పది మంది మహారథులు, పరివారంతో శ్రీకృష్ణుడు సమృద్ధ దేశాల గుండా ప్రయాణిస్తాడు; అపశకునాలు కనిపిస్తాయి, ప్రజలు ఆయనను చూడడానికి బయటకు వస్తారు. వృకస్థలంలో రాత్రి బస చేసి సంధ్యాకర్మలు చేసి బ్రాహ్మణులకు భోజనం పెడతాడు.
summary.ta: பத்து மகாரதர்களுடனும் பணியாளர் கூட்டத்துடனும் ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் செழிப்பான நாடுகள் வழியாகப் பயணிக்கிறார்; அபசகுனங்கள் தோன்ற, மக்கள் அவரைக் காண வெளிவருகிறார்கள். வ்ருகஸ்தலத்தில் இரவு தங்கி மாலைச் சடங்குகளைச் செய்து அந்தணர்களுக்கு உணவளிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: പത്തു മഹാവീരന്മാരോടും ഒരു വലിയ പരിവാരത്തോടുമൊപ്പം കൃഷ്ണൻ സമൃദ്ധമായ നാടുകളിലൂടെ യാത്ര ചെയ്യുന്നു; ദുർലക്ഷണങ്ങൾ പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെടുന്നു, ജനങ്ങൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ കാണാൻ പുറത്തിറങ്ങുന്നു. സന്ധ്യാകർമ്മങ്ങൾ ചെയ്ത്, ബ്രാഹ്മണരെ ഊട്ടി, രാത്രി വൃകസ്ഥലത്ത് തങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.82; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
प्रयान्तं देवकीपुत्रं परवीररुजो दश ।
महारथा महाबाहुमन्वयुः शस्त्रपाणयः ॥

meaning.en: As Devaki's son, the mighty-armed one, went on his way, ten great chariot-warriors, tormentors of enemy heroes, followed him with weapons in hand.

verses.text:
पदातीनां सहस्रं च सादिनां च परंतप ।
भोज्यं च विपुलं राजन्प्रेष्याश्च शतशोऽपरे ॥

meaning.en: Scorcher of foes, a thousand foot soldiers and horsemen went too, with plentiful food and hundreds of other servants.

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
कथं प्रयातो दाशार्हो महात्मा मधुसूदनः ।
कानि वा व्रजतस्तस्य निमित्तानि महौजसः ॥

meaning.en: How did the great-souled Madhusudana, descendant of Dasharha, travel, and what omens appeared for that mighty one as he went?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तस्य प्रयाणे यान्यासन्नद्भुतानि महात्मनः ।
तानि मे शृणु दिव्यानि दैवान्यौत्पातिकानि च ॥

meaning.en: Listen to me about the wonders that occurred on that great soul's journey, the divine and heaven-sent portents.

verses.text:
अनभ्रेऽशनिनिर्घोषः सविद्युत्समजायत ।
अन्वगेव च पर्जन्यः प्रावर्षद्विघने भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Without a cloud in the sky there was a thunderclap with lightning, and the rain god poured heavily after him.

verses.text:
प्रत्यगूहुर्महानद्यः प्राङ्मुखाः सिन्धुसत्तमाः ।
विपरीता दिशः सर्वा न प्राज्ञायत किंचन ॥

meaning.en: The great rivers, the finest eastward-flowing streams, flowed back; all the directions were reversed and nothing could be made out.

verses.text:
प्राज्वलन्नग्नयो राजन्पृथिवी समकम्पत ।
उदपानाश्च कुम्भाश्च प्रासिञ्चञ्शतशो जलम् ॥

meaning.en: Fires blazed, king, the earth shook, and wells and pots overflowed with hundreds of streams of water.

verses.text:
तमःसंवृतमप्यासीत्सर्वं जगदिदं तदा ।
न दिशो नादिशो राजन्प्रज्ञायन्ते स्म रेणुना ॥

meaning.en: The whole world was shrouded in darkness; neither directions nor intermediate directions could be told for the dust, king.

verses.text:
प्रादुरासीन्महाञ्शब्दः खे शरीरं न दृश्यते ।
सर्वेषु राजन्देशेषु तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: A great sound arose in the sky, though no body was seen; in all regions, king, it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
प्रामथ्नाद्धास्तिनपुरं वातो दक्षिणपश्चिमः ।
आरुजन्गणशो वृक्षान्परुषो भीमनिस्वनः ॥

meaning.en: A wind from the south-west shook Hastinapura, breaking trees in heaps, harsh and loud.

verses.text:
यत्र यत्र तु वार्ष्णेयो वर्तते पथि भारत ।
तत्र तत्र सुखो वायुः सर्वं चासीत्प्रदक्षिणम् ॥

meaning.en: But wherever Varshneya went on the road, Bharata, the wind blew pleasantly and everything moved in an auspicious direction.

verses.text:
ववर्ष पुष्पवर्षं च कमलानि च भूरिशः ।
समश्च पन्था निर्दुःखो व्यपेतकुशकण्टकः ॥

meaning.en: A shower of flowers fell, and lotuses in plenty; the road was smooth, free from trouble, without kusha grass or thorns.

verses.text:
स गच्छन्ब्राह्मणै राजंस्तत्र तत्र महाभुजः ।
अर्च्यते मधुपर्कैश्च सुमनोभिर्वसुप्रदः ॥

meaning.en: As the long-armed giver of wealth went on, brahmanas here and there honored him with honey-offerings and flowers.

verses.text:
तं किरन्ति महात्मानं वन्यैः पुष्पैः सुगन्धिभिः ।
स्त्रियः पथि समागम्य सर्वभूतहिते रतम् ॥

meaning.en: Women gathered on the road and scattered fragrant wild flowers over that great soul, who delights in the welfare of all beings.

verses.text:
स शालिभवनं रम्यं सर्वसस्यसमाचितम् ।
सुखं परमधर्मिष्ठमत्यगाद्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Bull of the Bharatas, he happily passed the lovely rice-growing lands, filled with all grains and most righteous.

verses.text:
पश्यन्बहुपशून्ग्रामान्रम्यान्हृदयतोषणान् ।
पुराणि च व्यतिक्रामन्राष्ट्राणि विविधानि च ॥

meaning.en: He saw many cattle, pleasant villages delighting the heart, and passed cities and many kingdoms.

verses.text:
नित्यहृष्टाः सुमनसो भारतैरभिरक्षिताः ।
नोद्विग्नाः परचक्राणामनयानामकोविदाः ॥

meaning.en: The people, ever glad and cheerful, were guarded by the Bharatas, unafraid of enemy armies, unacquainted with injustice.

verses.text:
उपप्लव्यादथायान्तं जनाः पुरनिवासिनः ।
पथ्यतिष्ठन्त सहिता विष्वक्सेनदिदृक्षया ॥

meaning.en: The townspeople gathered along the road from Upaplavya as he came, desiring to see Vishvaksena.

verses.text:
ते तु सर्वे सुनामानमग्निमिद्धमिव प्रभुम् ।
अर्चयामासुरर्च्यं तं देशातिथिमुपस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: All of them honored that lord of fine name, blazing like a lit fire, the honored guest who had come to their land.

verses.text:
वृकस्थलं समासाद्य केशवः परवीरहा ।
प्रकीर्णरश्मावादित्ये विमले लोहितायति ॥

meaning.en: Keshava, slayer of enemy heroes, reached Vrikasthala when the sun, its rays scattered, was clear and turning red.

verses.text:
अवतीर्य रथात्तूर्णं कृत्वा शौचं यथाविधि ।
रथमोचनमादिश्य संध्यामुपविवेश ह ॥

meaning.en: He got down quickly from the chariot, performed purification as prescribed, ordered the chariot unyoked, and sat to the twilight prayers.

verses.text:
दारुकोऽपि हयान्मुक्त्वा परिचर्य च शास्त्रतः ।
मुमोच सर्वं वर्माणि मुक्त्वा चैनानवासृजत् ॥

meaning.en: Daruka also unyoked the horses, tended them according to the texts, took off their harness and set them free.

verses.text:
अभ्यतीत्य तु तत्सर्वमुवाच मधुसूदनः ।
युधिष्ठिरस्य कार्यार्थमिह वत्स्यामहे क्षपाम् ॥

meaning.en: Having finished all that, Madhusudana said: for Yudhishthira's work we shall stay here for the night.

verses.text:
तस्य तन्मतमाज्ञाय चक्रुरावसथं नराः ।
क्षणेन चान्नपानानि गुणवन्ति समार्जयन् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing his wish, the men made a lodging, and in a moment prepared excellent food and drink.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्ग्रामे प्रधानास्तु य आसन्ब्राह्मणा नृप ।
आर्याः कुलीना ह्रीमन्तो ब्राह्मीं वृत्तिमनुष्ठिताः ॥

meaning.en: The chief brahmanas of that village, noble, well-born, modest, following the brahmanical way of life,

verses.text:
तेऽभिगम्य महात्मानं हृषीकेशमरिंदमम् ।
पूजां चक्रुर्यथान्यायमाशीर्मङ्गलसंयुताम् ॥

meaning.en: came to the great-souled Hrishikesha, subduer of foes, and honored him as is proper, with blessings and good wishes.

verses.text:
ते पूजयित्वा दाशार्हं सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम् ।
न्यवेदयन्त वेश्मानि रत्नवन्ति महात्मने ॥

meaning.en: Having honored Dasharha, who is honored in all the worlds, they offered their jewel-filled houses to that great soul.

verses.text:
तान्प्रभुः कृतमित्युक्त्वा सत्कृत्य च यथार्हतः ।
अभ्येत्य तेषां वेश्मानि पुनरायात्सहैव तैः ॥

meaning.en: The lord said: it is done, honored them rightly, visited their houses, and came back with them.

verses.text:
सुमृष्टं भोजयित्वा च ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र केशवः ।
भुक्त्वा च सह तैः सर्वैरवसत्तां क्षपां सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Keshava fed the brahmanas well-prepared food, ate with them all, and spent that night there comfortably.
